serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
DigiCert ONE is a unified digital trust platform that
delivers certificate lifecycle management, code signing
security, private PKI, and centralized access
governance for enterprise and government customers.
The platform is offered as a SaaS-based suite of four
integrated services:
DigiCert® Trust Lifecycle Manager (TLM) - CA-agnostic
certificate lifecycle management (CLM) providing discovery,
inventory, automated issuance and renewal, private CA
management, and integrations with ITSM and DevOps
toolchains across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises
environments.
DigiCert® Software Trust Manager (STM) - Code signing
and software supply chain security platform providing
centralized, policy-driven key and certificate management,
HSM-backed private key protection (FIPS 140-2 Level 3),
CI/CD pipeline integrations, multi-person approval
workflows, and tamperproof audit logging to support
compliance with EO 14028 and NIST SP 800-218.
DigiCert® Private CA - Private certificate authority platform
enabling organizations to create, manage, and operate
privately trusted root and intermediate CAs for issuing
certificates to internal users, devices, servers, and
workloads. Supports cloud-hosted, on-premises, and hybrid
deployment models with HSM-backed key protection and
post-quantum cryptography readiness.
DigiCert® Account Manager - Administrative and identity
governance layer of the DigiCert ONE platform providing
centralized user management, role-based access control
(RBAC), SSO/SAML configuration, API credential
management, organization management, and audit logging
across all DigiCert ONE services.

informationResources.summary:
DigiCert ONE (comprising Trust Lifecycle Manager,
Software Trust Manager, Private CA, and Account Manager)
is hosted on AWS GovCloud (US) in the US-East regions.
Key information resources include: the DigiCert ONE
application and API layer, the Certificate Authority (CA)
infrastructure with HSM-backed key storage (FIPS 140-2
Level 3), the certificate and signing event database and
audit log store, and customer identity/access management
integrations (SSO/SAML, RBAC)
informationResources.explicitExclusions:
CertCentral (public-trust TLS/SSL management portal) is
explicitly out of scope for this FedRAMP package. Public
Certificate Authority (CA) infrastructure including CRL/OCSP
services is also excluded per FedRAMP scope guidance
(fedramp.gov/scope). CA trust hierarchy operations are
governed separately under WebTrust and CA/B Forum
audits.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription:
DigiCert® Trust Lifecycle Manager (TLM) is a SaaS-based,
CA-agnostic certificate lifecycle management (CLM) and PKI
services platform built on the DigiCert ONE architecture.
TLM enables enterprise and government customers to
discover, inventory, automate, and govern digital certificates
(TLS/SSL, S/MIME, device, code signing) across cloud,
hybrid, and on-premises environments. Core capabilities
include certificate discovery and inventory, policy-based
issuance workflows, last-mile automation for servers and
devices, private CA creation and management, and
integrations with ITSM and DevOps toolchains. The platform
prevents certificate-related outages, reduces manual
operations overhead, and maintains continuous compliance
across the certificate estate.

DigiCert® Software Trust Manager (STM) is a SaaS-based
code signing and software supply chain security platform
built on the DigiCert ONE architecture. STM provides
centralized, policy-driven management of code signing keys
and certificates, with private keys protected in FIPS 140-2
Level 3 hardware security modules (HSMs). It integrates
natively with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps,
GitHub Actions, Gradle) and supports remote signing via
API, CLI (SMCTL), and pre-built DevOps connectors. STM
enforces multi-person approval workflows, tracks all signing
activity in tamperproof audit logs, and helps organizations
comply with government software supply chain security
mandates including EO 14028 and NIST SP 800-218.

DigiCert® Private CA (also known as CA Manager / Private
PKI Services) is a SaaS and on-premises private certificate
authority platform within the DigiCert ONE suite. It enables
organizations to create, manage, and operate privately
trusted root and intermediate CAs for issuing certificates to
internal users, devices, servers, and workloads. Key
capabilities include HSM-backed key protection (FIPS 140-2
Level 3), support for post-quantum cryptography (ML-DSA
via Crypto4A HSMs), OCSP/CRL publishing, SCEP and
EST enrollment protocol support, and integration with
DigiCert Trust Lifecycle Manager for unified certificate
lifecycle governance. Supports deployment models including
cloud-hosted managed PKI, customer-managed on-
premises, and hybrid.

DigiCert® Account Manager is the administrative and
identity governance layer of the DigiCert ONE platform. It
provides centralized user management, role-based access
control (RBAC), single sign-on (SSO/SAML) configuration,
API token and service user credential management,
organization management, and audit logging across all
DigiCert ONE services (including Trust Lifecycle Manager,
Software Trust Manager, Private CA, and Device Trust
Manager). Account Manager is bundled with all DigiCert
ONE subscriptions and is the authoritative access control
plane for the platform. Note: Account Manager is a platform
module, not a standalone purchasable product; it is included
with each of the above service subscriptions.

certified.useCase:
AWS GovCloud (US) provides the foundational cloud
infrastructure for all DigiCert ONE services — Trust Lifecycle
Manager, Software Trust Manager, Private CA, and Account
Manager — deployed across US-East regions for
redundancy and high availability.
certified.justificationForUse:
AWS GovCloud is the only AWS partition designed for US
government workloads, with ITAR-compliant infrastructure,
physical access restricted to US persons, and FedRAMP
High authorization. Deployment across three availability
zones within us-gov-east-1 satisfies DigiCert ONE's high-
availability and fault-tolerance requirements for federal
customers.
certified.mitigationMeasures:
DigiCert applies application-level encryption on top of AWS
native encryption, ensuring AWS personnel cannot access
federal customer data in plaintext. Access to GovCloud
environments is restricted to vetted DigiCert personnel via
MFA-enforced IAM roles with least-privilege policies. AWS
CloudTrail logs and AWS Config are continuously monitored
for unauthorized changes.
certified.compensatingControls:
• Application-layer encryption — federal customer
data is encrypted with DigiCert-managed keys
certified.securityCategory:
High (AWS GovCloud is authorized at FedRAMP High,
Class D — DigiCert ONE operates at Moderate, inheriting a
subset of High controls)
